verdict.rationale: Databricks delivers AI-generated insights natively via Genie (natural-language Q&A grounded in org data), AI/BI dashboards with AI-assisted authoring, automatic query optimization insights/recommendations, and Genie Code that generates code, builds pipelines/dashboards, and works with Unity Catalog lineage — all inside the product surface. This is well-documented first-party functionality spanning multiple product areas (SQL, dashboards, Genie), though independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality is thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight accuracy or usefulness beyond vendor docs.
